Erath TX-Comanche TX-
1027 PM CST Mon Nov 2 2026

...A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 1045 PM CST
FOR NORTHWESTERN ERATH AND NORTH CENTRAL COMANCHE COUNTIES...

At 1026 PM CST, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Huckabay to 6 miles north of Dublin, moving
northeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Stephenville, Dublin, De Leon, Comyn, Harbin, Lingleville, Bunyan,
and Highland.

PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

A Tornado Watch remains in effect until 1100 PM CST for central and
north central Texas.

For your protection stay inside a sturdy structure and keep away from
windows.
